name: Freeyourgadget/Gadgetbridge
what_it_is: Gadgetbridge is an Android application (API 21+) that acts as a cloud-free, vendor-independent companion app for Bluetooth wearables, headphones, scales, trackers, and other gadgets. It communicates directly with devices over Bluetooth without requiring vendor accounts or sending data to external servers.
components: Android foreground service for persistent BLE/Bluetooth Classic device connections
GreenDAO SQLite database for local activity and health data storage
Charts/dashboard UI for visualizing health metrics
Device protocol implementations per vendor (Pebble, Huami/Xiaomi, Garmin, Huawei/Honor, Fossil, Sony, Bangle.js, and many others)
Notification listener service for forwarding Android notifications to devices
Intent API for third-party app integration and automation
Health Connect integration layer for exporting data to Android Health Connect
Internet Helper add-on interface for Pebble app store and watchface access
ZIP export/import for database backup and restore
protocols: Garmin protocol (including Garmin Protobuf and FIT file format)
measurement: Sleep stages (light, deep, REM, restless moments)
configuration: Per-device notification filtering and forwarding rules
Calendar sync settings with event filtering
modes: Normal mode: persistent background service with automatic reconnect
Debug mode: verbose logging, packet inspection, raw data fetch
Nightly build flavor with more frequent updates
constraints: Android-only; no iOS, desktop, or server component
No cloud sync; all data stays local on-device unless user explicitly exports
Device support is community-contributed and varies widely in completeness per model
ECG and some health features can be activated but raw data may have no UI for some devices
Pebble app store and watchface features require the optional Internet Helper add-on
Vendor firmware updates may break existing protocol implementations
No multi-user or remote-monitoring server component; single-phone, single-database architecture
notable_absences: No cloud backend or server component of any kind
No web UI or REST API for data access
No iOS or cross-platform desktop client
No built-in data sharing or multi-device synchronization across phones
No real-time streaming export to external time-series databases
No built-in ECG interpretation or medical analysis; raw data only
